en.headline: sogeisetsu: 14 own commits in 3 repos, 28 automated, one discussion started
en.summary: sogeisetsu logged **14 own commits** across three repos, plus **28 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]`. Seven went to `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`: implementing the `skill_management` plugin (list/inspect/disable/enable), moving plans to `.openchamber/plans` and switching line endings to LF. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` six own commits refreshed `AGENTS.md`, stopped duplicate creation of the resident issue, narrowed the additive-phrasing invariant in `verify`, and reworked AI failure visibility, model labeling and the 30-day summary. One commit in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` added an `opencode-provider` knowledge category on catalog sources, credentials and endpoints. Issue activity was 1 item: a comment on `openchamber/openchamber`#4939 about the rendered-page selection menu. sogeisetsu started discussion `openchamber/openchamber`#5114, proposing to split that fix with the frame→host selection bridge first. Two replies arrived: `btriapitsyn` said #4601 was fixed in `7d037b07d`, and `yulia-ivashko` could not reproduce #4899 at 150% or 200% scaling. `btriapitsyn` also closed #4896, #4920 and #4601; no pull requests, reviews or releases were recorded.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：3 个仓库 14 次本人提交，另有 28 次自动提交，新开 1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-18，sogeisetsu 在三个仓库共完成 **14 次本人提交**，另有 `github-actions[bot]` 的 **28 次自动提交**。其中 7 次在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`：实现 `skill_management` 插件（list/inspect/disable/enable），把计划移到 `.openchamber/plans`，并将换行符统一为 LF。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 6 次本人提交，刷新了 `AGENTS.md`，修复常住 issue 被重复创建的问题，收窄 `verify` 中「相加表述」不变式的扫描范围，并改版 AI 失败可见性、模型标注与 30 天总结。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 有 1 次提交，新增 `opencode-provider` 知识类别，涵盖 catalog 来源、凭据归属与端点。issue 相关活动共 1 项：在 `openchamber/openchamber`#4939 下留言，讨论渲染页内选中文字无法唤出评论菜单的问题。sogeisetsu 新开了讨论 `openchamber/openchamber`#5114，建议先做 frame→host 选区桥接，再拆分该修复。收到两条回复：`btriapitsyn` 表示 #4601 已在 `7d037b07d` 修复；`yulia-ivashko` 表示在 150% 与 200% 缩放下无法复现 #4899。`btriapitsyn` 还关闭了 #4896、#4920 和 #4601；当天没有 PR、评审或发布。
